body:
Advisor review of the Codex docs stack PR-3096..3103 (2026-10-29 13:45). Rule-once: everything below goes into ONE restack push. No follow-up PRs.

STACK (blocking): the stack is based on the pre-squash branches of #3093/#3094, so #3096 is CONFLICTING and #3103 re-adds content main already has. Rebase the whole stack onto current main, drop the pre-merge #3093/#3094 commits, and retarget each PR's base so it lands bottom-up. Conflicts are in docs/showcase/{README.md,index.html,styles.css} and docs/what-is-aida.{md,html}. RULING on what-is-aida.md:3: keep main's #3093 sentence ("AIDA is a governed software factory with selectable autonomy: ..."). Regenerate the HTML with build.py.

PR-3102 (blocking): README.md "Cloning an existing AIDA project" must keep "run `aida init` (or `aida node acquire`) in the clone before creating specs". Verified: in a fresh clone `aida add` fails ("requirement ID allocation failed") until `aida init` runs. Add the same step to docs/operator-setup.md, and drop the "reinitializing" warning in getting-started.md or qualify it. Also restore the still-true content the rewrite dropped: `[store.allocation] retry_max` + the duplicate-ID refusal (storage-modes.md), `aida queue list --sync` and the `git -C .aida-store log origin/aida-store..aida-store` check (multi-node.md).

Bundle these cheap fixes:
- 3096: first-project.md "full inventory ... getting-started.md#one-time-operator-setup" → point to docs/cli/01-getting-started.md (aida init section); drop the duplicated getting-started paragraph (first-project.md:19-24); restore a short Uninstall section.
- 3099: trust-and-evidence.md:15 solo-exception reference → docs/review-process.md; selectable-autonomy.md:16 "selector below" → say it is on the autonomy page.
- 3100: what-is-aida.md Appendix B items 29-31 cite the deleted RECORDS TODAY table, so fix them; link metrics-guide.md, not showcase/metrics.html; keep the caveat that current models come out unpriced (rates cover two old Claude models); reword "Effort is not post-hoc only."
- 3101: showcase/README.md "PAGES" → publication.json; remove the "awaits PR review" process notes.
- 3103: fix docs/README.md:5 anchor (#3-deciding-whether-to-adopt) and docs/positioning/README.md:7,52 links; report re-run instructions should not hardcode pre-squash SHAs.
ACCEPTED as-is (reason: low value, no reader harm): the dropped spec dryrun/lint/criteria/perf rows from the old table; the remaining "reference-requires-context" links in mailbox.md and using-aida-with-claude-code.md.
3097, 3098, 3099, 3100, 3101 and 3103 otherwise passed command-by-command verification. After the restack, every PR gets a fresh review at its new head, and the advisor ships bottom-up.
subject: Docs stack 3096-3103: restack onto main + review rulings
